subject: Post-call recap: Procurement runway & PO vs Card decision — BrightLeaf
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@brightleaf.com>, Mike Reynolds <mike@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Procurement runway & PO vs Card decision — BrightLeaf

Hi Tara / Mike —

Thanks for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep the procurement runway tight: 

Summary (from our discovery)
- Commercial path: primary preference is corporate PO for enterprise purchases above $50k; card OK for pilot/POC purchases under $10k.
- Marketplace interest: evaluating but Marketplace purchase will require Marketplace contract sign-off from your legal/finance.
- Procurement gate sequence (expected): Legal review -> Security review (security questionnaire & SOC2) -> Finance approval -> PO issuance.

Proposed timeline (ballpark from your comments):
- Legal review: ~2 weeks after receiving SOW/TS&C
- Security review: ~2–3 weeks (SOC2 + answers to security questionnaire)
- Finance & PO issuance: 3–7 business days post-approvals

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (draft MAP with owners and dates)

Asks / next steps
1) Tara/Mike: can you confirm the timeline above and whether PO threshold (~$50k) is accurate for BrightLeaf?
2) Tara: please indicate whether Marketplace is actively preferred or just being evaluated for the pilot.
3) Ben/Karthik/Priyom (internal): we’ll prepare the standard SOW, SOC2 link, and a pricing/PO vs card cost comparison for the pilot vs committed path.
4) Schedule: propose a 30-min procurement walkthrough with your procurement and legal to review MAP — available windows Thurs 8/27 or Mon 8/31. Please pick one.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced): mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx
From: Tara Singh <tara@brightleaf.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Reynolds <mike@brightleaf.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Procurement runway & PO vs Card decision — BrightLeaf

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Confirming the sequence you listed is how we typically run this. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PO threshold: correct that for BrightLeaf purchases >$50k we require a PO (and standard terms routed through our procurement portal). For purchases <$10k we use departmental card. Between $10k–$50k depends on the lines of business; finance triages.
- Marketplace: we are open to Marketplace for fast pilots but the legal team needs to confirm Marketplace terms vs our Master Services Agreement. For the pilot we are leaning toward card because it’s small and needs fast turnaround.
- Timeline: estimate below (subject to legal calendar)
  * Legal review: 10–14 business days after you share SOW + redlines
  * Security review: 8–15 business days (we’ll require SOC2 Type II and answers to our security questionnaire)
  * Finance / PO: once approvals are in, typically 3–5 business days to issue PO

We attached our internal RFI answers to help speed the security review. Also: our legal will likely request a few edits to your standard SOW around indemnity and data processing. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept our reciprocity language or whether you require Redwood’s standard limits?

I can do a 30-min procurement walkthrough on Mon 8/31 at 10:00 AM PT. Mike will join from finance.

Thanks,
Tara Singh
Head of Procurement, BrightLeaf Corp
tara@brightleaf.com | +1 617-555-0789

Attachment: BrightLeaf_RFI_answers.docx

Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Procurement runway & PO vs Card decision — BrightLeaf

Tara — great, appreciate the clarity and the RFI — that will speed things up.

Quick responses: 
- SOW & terms: we’ll share our standard SOW and a redline-ready version for your legal to mark up. We’ll also highlight the clauses that traditionally draw comment (liability caps, data processing, IP rights).
- SOC2: Karthik will share our SOC2 report and security questionnaire responses ahead of the walkthrough.
- Marketplace vs card: noted that pilot likely via card. We’ll include both card and PO pricing in the MAP so finance can see the delta.

Confirmed for Mon 8/31 10:00 AM PT for the procurement walkthrough. I’ll send a calendar invite with a proposed agenda (SOW, security artifacts, timeline, next milestones).

Ben
